bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-ui-05849c)" || exit 62
code="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT data->>'shareCode' FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='link' AND data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト' AND data ? 'shareCode';")" || exit 63
test "${#code}" -eq 24 || exit 64
cd "$root"
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 1e5b41d236ea47de214ed29eeea9477bcec539a6 || exit 66
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-saved-verification.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py > "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 67
test "$(git hash-object "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py")" = "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_test_client.py)" || exit 68
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 69
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_inline_query_smoke --code "$code" >/dev/null || exit 80
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" link_send_saved_smoke --code "$code" >/dev/null || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 82
PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || exit 83
echo LINK_INLINE_SEARCH=PASS
echo LINK_SAVED_MESSAGE_URL_BUTTONS=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
